intro.title: Doctor Master Directory
intro.subtitle: Prescriber master data, MCI registration numbers, clinic affiliations, and instant POS integration

narration.text: Welcome to Phase 3, Part 3: Managing the Doctor Master Directory. A verified prescriber database is the backbone of statutory compliance and seamless prescription dispensing.
Navigate to Compliance and click Doctors. MediFlow displays your complete registry of registered medical practitioners, qualifications, and state council numbers.
Click Add Doctor to enroll a new prescriber. Enter the physician's full name, State Medical Council registration number, specialization, and affiliated hospital or clinic.
Click Save Prescriber. The doctor profile is immediately validated and available across all counter billing terminals for one-click compliance selection.
Maintain up-to-date prescriber records to guarantee audit compliance. In Part 4, discover how to record Digital Inward Patient Prescriptions.

outro.takeaway: Doctor Master Directory: Maintain verified prescriber credentials and MCI registration numbers for instant counter billing and airtight audit compliance.
